RaggieSoft StoreTrainer v1.0 (Retro PC Game & Trainer Manager)

RaggieSoft StoreTrainer (TStore.exe) is a 100% hand-written (pre-AI, 2018–2020) desktop utility authored by Michael P. Ragsdale in Visual Basic 6.0 (TStore.vbp) inside a Windows 2000 Professional SP4 virtual machine. It indexes, stores, and launches classic and modern PC games alongside their associated game trainers (cheat utilities) and custom launch options across classic and modern PCs.

💾 Download Official Installer: tssetup100.exe 🔍 Inspect VB6 & .NET Source Code (18 Files) → 📦 Inspect NSIS Wizard95 Installer Scripts →

Why StoreTrainer Was Built (2018–2020)

Many classic 1990s and 2000s PC games require either specific launch switches (such as resolution overrides, windowed mode, or mod directory flags) or companion game trainers that must be launched in the proper working directory before or alongside the game.

Built inside a Windows 2000 Professional SP4 environment without heavy third-party dependencies, StoreTrainer runs just as cleanly on a classic 1990s retro gaming PC as it does on a modern desktop.

Saved Game Profile (.sfile) Format

StoreTrainer saves each game profile as a simple, human-readable 6-line text file (<GameName>.sfile) alongside StoreTrainer.cfg: 

Line 1: GameName     (Display title in the StoreTrainer list)
Line 2: GameFile     (Full path to the game .exe binary)
Line 3: GameArgs     (Optional command-line switches for the game)
Line 4: TrainerFile  (Full path to the companion trainer .exe, or empty)
Line 5: TrainerArgs  (Optional command-line switches for the trainer)
Line 6: GamePath     (Working directory passed to ShellExecuteA)
Line 7: TrainerPath  (Trainer working directory passed to ShellExecuteA)

Supported PC Systems

System Era Supported Releases Notes
Classic 1990s PCs Windows 95, Windows 98, Windows 98 SE, Windows ME Includes the Visual Basic 6.0 runtime library if not already installed.
Classic 2000s PCs Windows NT 4.0, Windows 2000 Professional SP4, Windows XP Original Design Era: Created and tested inside Windows 2000 Professional SP4.
Modern PCs Windows Vista, Windows 7, Windows 8.1, Windows 10, and newer Works out of the box with both the classic edition and the included TStore.NET edition.
